name: FilterBar
label: Filter bar
description: A row of filter chips for narrowing a collection, each opening a popover of options, with per-filter and clear-all resets.

props.name: filters
props.description: The filters on the bar, in display order.

props.name: values
props.description: Active options per filter id (controlled). Pair with `onValuesChange`.

props.name: defaultValues
props.description: Active options per filter id (uncontrolled initial state).

props.name: onValuesChange
props.description:
Fires with the full active-filter map on every change. Filters with
nothing active are absent from the map, so an empty object means
unfiltered.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Label for the button that clears every filter at once.

props.name: clearFilterLabel
props.description: Accessible name of an active filter's own clear button, given the filter's label. Defaults to "Clear" followed by the label.

FilterBarFilter.description: One filter: a chip on the bar with a popover of options behind it.

FilterBarOption.description: One choice inside a filter's popover.
